name: Hikawa Rina
source:
Rina is an underclassman to Naoya. After Rin moved away, Naoya began to play with her. She looks up to Naoya as her big brother.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sakura_no_Uta]Wikipedia[/url]]
